title: 云海仙踪 更隔蓬山一万重 第八十八章 桃源云海仙踪 第二卷 更隔蓬山一万重八十九章 遗世
slug: 云海仙踪更隔蓬山一万重
content_zh:
许宣、小青打着火折子打量四周，只见那洞窟四壁奇石嶙峋，分布着许多黑漆漆的蚀洞，洞顶垂着许多钟乳石，被火光映照，光怪陆离，迷幻而又瑰丽。
洞窟中央坐着一对少年男女，身着奇怪的衣裳，不是宋服，也不像是金国、大理、西夏等番邦的服饰，背靠着背，全身被青黑色的锁链紧紧捆缚，就像两个绑在一起的粽子。
少年大约十六七岁，黝黑结实;少女不过十四五岁，白皙清秀，嘴巴俱被布条塞住，满脸惊骇恐惧，眼见许宣举着火折子朝他们走来，拼命挣扎，却怎么也无法挪动身体。
许宣又惊又奇，刚伸手摘下少女口中的布条，脑中忽然“嗡”地一响，气血翻腾，又听见青龙闷雷般的狂吼声，虽隔着厚厚的山壁，仍觉郁闷欲呕。
继而咆哮连连，轰鸣阵阵，整个洞壁仿佛都在随着吼声剧烈颤动，钟乳石摇摇欲坠，不断有碎石簌簌震落。
少女尖声大叫，刺得他耳膜都快破了。忽听“轰”地一声巨响，白光耀眼，石块碎炸如雨，火折子被迎面鼓舞的狂风陡然吹灭。
他后心被一块飞石撞中，眼前一黑，鼻子里、嘴里腥甜直涌，重重地撞在那对少年男女身上，翻身急滚。
所幸小青反应极快，一把抓住他的衣领，冲入洞壁的熔洞，这才免于被纵横飞舞的乱石砸中。
尘土弥漫，隆隆声回荡不绝。
许宣惊魂未定，鼻息间尽是浓烈的腥臭之气，抬头望去，那坚不可摧的石壁赫然也被豁出一个长、宽近两三丈的大洞，狂风呼啸涌入。那少年已被乱石砸得晕了过去，少女侧身蜷缩，犹自尖声大叫。
许宣与小青对望一眼，惊疑骇异，不知究竟是怎么回事。
他定了定神，忍痛跃出蚀洞，将那少女扶起，道：“小娘子，莫怕。我姓许，单名一个宣字，是大宋临安人士……”
少女浑身颤抖，摇头嘶声哭叫，飞快地说了一连串也不知是哪儿的方言，见他愕然不解，更加惶急恐惧，脸色惨白，泪水涟涟涌出。
许宣心中一凛，顺着少女惊恐的目光朝那豁穿的洞口望去，却见悬崖环立，霞云离散，一座座悬山浮在澄净的蓝空中，千峰竞秀，壮丽无比，已全然不是先前那天崩地裂的恐怖景象，
他松了口气，一边温言安抚她，一边用力挣扯她身上的锁链。铁链被紧紧锁扣，纹丝不动。
待要拔出“龙牙”劈斫，腰带里却空空如也。左右打量，才发现刚才翻身飞滚时，匕首恰好掉入了洞角的石隙。
许宣奔到洞角，刚拔出匕首，忽听少女发出凄厉无比的尖叫，还不等转头，又听“嗷——呜——”一声狂吼，如雷霆般在他头顶炸开，震得他满眼金星乱舞，一跤跌坐在地。
几乎就在同时，狂风鼓舞，猛地将那少年、少女掀得翻身飞起，紧紧地贴在石壁上，肌肤如波浪般簌簌起伏。
他正好坐在一块凸起的岩石后，挡住了大半狂风，饶是如此，仍被刮得发丝乱舞，呼吸不得。睁眼从石头缝隙朝洞外望去，心底一沉，浑身的寒毛全都乍起来了。
青龙

那条狂暴无比、势可毁天灭地的青龙赫然已冲到了洞外
青鳞耀眼，腥风狂卷。它咆哮着在洞外夭矫飞舞，龙尾猛烈地撞击着山壁，洞窟乱石迸落，轰隆连震，整个山峰仿佛随时都将坍塌。
那对少年、少女被狂风凌空抵在石壁上，肌肤簌簌乱抖，五官血丝沁出，惊怖得直翻白眼。
许宣紧紧地抓着石沿，双脚被刮得腾空飞起，眼睛已经被酸风刺得睁不开来了，全身浸满了冷汗。
先前在海上相隔尚远，这孽畜的威力已让他窒息，此时相距仅有几丈，简直就像悬吊在鬼门关前，恐怖得难以形容。
青龙怒吼着飞旋了几圈，突然迎头疾冲而来，“轰”天摇地动。庞大的身躯虽然无法钻入洞窟，但那血盆巨口却紧紧地抵住了洞口外沿，涎水暴雨般地喷洒飞溅，腥风倒卷。
许宣呼吸一窒，再也支撑不住，左手一松，右肩、后背、膝盖顿时接连重重地磕撞在石壁上，朝那孽畜腥臭的巨口冲去。
说时迟那时快，绿影飞闪，小青的丝带突然紧紧地缠住了他的腰腿，将他猛地往旁边拽去。
content_en:
Xu Xuan and Xiao Qing looked around with the fire seal, and saw that the walls of the cave were jagged with strange rocks, and there were many dark caves. There were many stalactites hanging from the top of the cave, which were illuminated by the firelight, making them strange, psychedelic and magnificent.
In the center of the cave sat a pair of young men and women, wearing strange clothes. They were not clothes of the Song Dynasty, nor did they look like the clothes of the Jin Dynasty, Dali, Xixia and other foreign countries. They were back to back, and their whole bodies were tightly bound by blue-black chains, like two rice dumplings tied together.
The boy was about 16 or 17 years old, dark and strong; the girl was only 14 or 15 years old, fair and delicate, her mouth was gagged with a piece of cloth, her face was full of horror and fear. Seeing Xu Xuan walking towards them holding a fire fold, she struggled desperately, but couldn't move her body.
Xu Xuan was shocked and surprised. He had just stretched out his hand to take off the cloth from the girl's mouth, when suddenly there was a "buzzing" sound in his head, his blood was boiling, and he heard the thunderous roar of the green dragon. Even though he was separated by the thick mountain wall, he still felt depressed and nauseous.
Then there were roars and roars, and the entire cave wall seemed to be shaking violently with the roars. The stalactites were crumbling, and gravels kept falling.
The girl screamed so hard that his eardrums almost burst. Suddenly there was a loud "boom", white light was dazzling, stones exploded like rain, and the fire was suddenly blown out by the strong wind blowing in the face.
He was hit in the back of the heart by a flying stone, his vision went dark, and a fishy sweetness surged from his nose and mouth. He hit the young man and woman heavily and rolled over.
Fortunately, Xiao Qing reacted very quickly, grabbed him by the collar, and rushed into the molten hole on the cave wall, thus avoiding being hit by the flying rocks.
Dust filled the air and rumbles echoed endlessly.
Xu Xuan was still in shock. His breath was filled with a strong stench. He looked up and saw that a large hole nearly two to three feet long and three feet wide had been cut out of the indestructible stone wall, and a strong wind was pouring in. The young man had been knocked unconscious by the rocks, and the girl huddled sideways, screaming.
Xu Xuan and Xiao Qing looked at each other, surprised and confused, not knowing what was going on.
He calmed down, reluctantly jumped out of the cave, helped the girl up, and said: "Little lady, don't be afraid. My surname is Xu, and I have the character "Xuan" in my name. I am from Lin'an in the Song Dynasty..."
The girl trembled all over, shook her head and cried hoarsely, speaking a series of dialects that she didn't know where she came from quickly. Seeing that he was stunned and confused, she became even more anxious and fearful, her face was pale, and tears welled up in her eyes.
Xu Xuan's heart trembled. He followed the girl's frightened eyes and looked towards the gaping cave entrance. He saw cliffs surrounding each other, scattered clouds, and mountains floating in the clear blue sky. Thousands of peaks competed with each other, and they were extremely majestic. It was no longer the terrifying scene of the earth shattering that day before.
He breathed a sigh of relief, comforted her with gentle words, and tugged hard on the chains on her body. The chain was tightly locked and motionless.
When he was about to pull out the "Dragon Tooth" and chop it, his belt was empty. Looking around, he realized that when he rolled over just now, the dagger had fallen into the stone gap in the corner of the cave.
Xu Xuan ran to the corner of the cave, and just as he pulled out the dagger, he suddenly heard the girl let out a shrill scream. Before he could turn around, he heard another roar of "Ouch - Woo -", which exploded above his head like thunder, causing his eyes to be filled with dancing stars, and he fell to the ground.
Almost at the same time, the strong wind whipped up the young man and the young girl, causing them to fly up and cling tightly to the stone wall, their skin rippling like waves.
He happened to be sitting behind a raised rock, blocking most of the strong wind. Even so, his hair was still blown wildly and he couldn't breathe. Opening his eyes and looking out of the cave through the cracks in the rocks, his heart sank and all the hairs on his body stood up.
Qinglong
The extremely violent green dragon that can destroy heaven and earth has suddenly rushed out of the cave.
The green scales are dazzling, and the fishy wind is blowing wildly. It roared and flew wildly outside the cave. The dragon's tail violently hit the mountain wall. Rocks fell from the cave and there were rumblings and earthquakes. The entire mountain seemed to collapse at any time.
The boy and girl were pushed up against the stone wall by the strong wind, their skin rustling.Shaking, bloodshot eyes appeared on his facial features, and he rolled his eyes in horror.
Xu Xuan clung to the edge of the stone tightly, his feet were blown into the air, his eyes were stung by the acid wind and he could not open his eyes, and his whole body was soaked in cold sweat.
Previously, they were far apart on the sea, but the power of this evil beast had suffocated him. Now they were only a few feet apart, and it was like they were hanging in front of the gate of hell. It was so terrifying that it was indescribable.
The green dragon roared and flew around for several times, then suddenly charged head-on, shaking the sky and the earth with a "boom". Although the huge body could not get into the cave, the bloody mouth tightly pressed against the outer edge of the cave entrance, saliva sprayed and splashed like a rainstorm, and the fishy wind blew back.
Xu Xuan's breath was suffocated, and he could no longer hold on. He let go of his left hand, and his right shoulder, back, and knees suddenly hit the stone wall heavily one after another, and he rushed towards the smelly mouth of the evil beast.
Soon enough, green shadows flashed, and Xiaoqing's ribbon suddenly wrapped tightly around his waist and legs, pulling him violently to the side.
